text: Floodwaters have reached the city centre following overnight rainfall.
Authorities have begun deploying rescue boats along the main boulevard.
Residents are urged to move to higher ground and await official guidance.
The mayor declared a state of emergency effective at midnight.
Deep within the Mekong Delta lies one of Asia's most biodiverse wetlands.
The Irrawaddy dolphin, critically endangered, surfaces near the riverbank.
Conservationists have counted only twelve individuals remaining in this stretch.
And it's a stunning opener from Vietnam in the 3rd minute!
Thailand struggles to find their footing in this high-tempo match.
Vietnam doubles their lead just before half-time — the crowd erupts!
Full-time whistle — Vietnam are your 2026 AFF Champions!
